Markets.title: ICICI Bank, Federal Bank among top bank picks by Axis Direct after Q1 earnings season
Markets.summary: Axis Direct has named ICICI Bank and Federal Bank among its top banking sector picks following the Q1 earnings season. The brokerage's selection is based on the recent financial performance reported by these institutions during the quarter.

Markets.title: Jefferies retains Buy on Crompton Greaves; sees up to 29% upside
Markets.summary: Jefferies has maintained its Buy rating on Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals with a price target of Rs 330, suggesting a potential upside of nearly 29%. The brokerage anticipates that the company's premiumisation strategy, market share gains, and margin expansion will drive strong revenue and earnings growth through FY29.

Markets.title: India bonds hang tight before supply as oil stalls
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds stabilized on Friday morning as oil prices leveled off following a recent spike and hawkish central bank minutes. A major debt sale later today will test investor demand amidst pressures from rising retail inflation, global yields, and crude prices.

Markets.title: US Treasury bond buybacks spark fresh fears over dollar weakness
Markets.summary: The US Treasury's expanded bond-buyback program has sparked concerns that lowering borrowing costs could weaken the dollar. This policy coincides with intense market scrutiny over rising yields, fiscal deficits, and heavy debt issuance.

Markets.title: Tata Steel, Adani Ports among top 10 stocks downgraded by Motilal Oswal after Q1 results
Markets.summary: Following Q1 results, brokerage firm Motilal Oswal downgraded Tata Steel, Adani Ports, and eight other major Indian stocks. The adjustments reflect updated market evaluations of these companies' recent quarterly financial performances.

Markets.title: 2 Mold-Tek Group companies to consider bonus issues on August 26. Do you own?
Markets.summary: Board meetings will be held on August 26 by Mold-Tek Packaging and Mold-Tek Technologies to consider bonus issues and dividends. Both stocks have delivered strong long-term gains, and Mold-Tek Packaging is currently a top midcap pick for Axis Securities.

Geo-Political.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
Geo-Political.summary: Thirty Israeli families have moved into a previously closed West Bank settlement backed by the national government. This action has sparked international protests and left nearby Palestinian residents feeling fearful.

Geo-Political.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: The UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Canada condemned Israel's plans to expand settlements in the occupied West Bank. The nations argue that these settlement projects undermine regional stability and efforts toward a two-state solution.

Geo-Political.title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has historically managed to evade severe international economic sanctions. It remains unclear how much new US pressure, described as an economic D-Day, would further damage the Iranian economy.

Geo-Political.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
Geo-Political.summary: Three former Hong Kong activists organizing annual Tiananmen Square vigils were found guilty of inciting subversion of state power. They were convicted under a Beijing-imposed national security law for refusing to dissolve their alliance.

Geo-Political.title: Five missing after fire in Swiss Alpine town
Geo-Political.summary: A fire in a Swiss Alpine town has left five people missing and eight others injured. Local police are currently investigating the cause of the fire.

Geo-Political.title: Bali jails Swiss tourist for insulting sacred Day of Silence

Data & Insights.summary: Private sector growth in India recovered in August from July's low, driven by a strengthening service sector. This advance HSBC Flash India PMI survey provides an early indication of positive shifts in economic output and sentiment.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Fears that ethanol-blended E20 petrol reduces vehicle mileage and engine life have caused consumers to increasingly purchase premium, high-octane fuel. Consequently, the sales share of premium petrol surged from about 4% in March to between 12% and 15%.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has reduced its sugar import duty to zero to help lower record-high domestic prices. This action follows earlier government measures that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sector growth slowed to 5.4% in July compared to a revised 6% in June. This expansion was primarily driven by the iron ore, cement, and electricity sectors.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. This limited impact depends on whether the Reserve Bank of India absorbs the foreign currency inflows as reserves rather than releasing them into the market.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated in the August MPC meeting minutes that the central bank requires clear evidence of persistent inflation before taking action. Consequently, the rate-setting panel hinted at potential future policy tightening if high prices continue.
